source: Codex re-probe c3 (sleep 75, interrupt), 0.159.2, 2026-09-30; the stop here is the wall deadline instead of a caller interrupt

params.prompt: Run the shell command sleep 75. Then say done.

expect.notes: At the wall Route fails the turn with the typed Deadline failure, and its one cleanup step for Codex is turn/interrupt, written before run_turn returns; the shared server is never closed (C2 §4.1 Wall expiry, What is per route). The interrupted terminal arrives within S1's 3 s cleanup bound, so the failure carries acknowledged:true and shared:true; Core then gives failed(deadline_wall) with cancel.outcome acknowledged. The wall has passed, so P7's cap settles cleanup at once: the tool item is still open, so uncertain (C2 §4.1 Core handoff). Whether TurnEnd.terminal also carries the post-wall interrupted terminal is not fixed by C2, so terminal is unasserted.
